## Example: multi-turn tool conversation

```bash
llm -m gemini-3-flash-preview --functions functions/render_svg.py "Make me a pelican riding a bicycle"
llm -c -m gemini-3-flash-preview --functions functions/render_svg.py "Give the pelican a top hat"
llm -c -m gemini-3-flash-preview --functions functions/render_threejs.py "Turn it into a 3D scene"
```
